metric_definitions.embedding_collapse_score: Mean off-diagonal cosine mapped to [0,1], excluding padding and zero-norm embeddings. Directional concentration only, not recommendation diversity. Null with fewer than two observations.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean positive-minus-negative score where input, positive and negative are nonzero; sampled training separability, not validation accuracy. Null without support.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: 10th percentile of (pos_logit - neg_logit); lower suggests many hard/confusing cases.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction where neg_logit > pos_logit (margin < 0); lower is better.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction where (pos_logit - neg_logit) < eps; higher means weak separation.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown: Counts valid training positions, margins below eps=0.5 and margins below zero. Item categories are unavailable; category lists remain empty.
